description.text: My manager asked me to help prepare a report in the shared folder Board-Reports.
When I open it, a message appears: "Access denied. You do not have permission to this folder on server fs01.nusadigital.test."
I can open the Sales folder on the same server as usual.
My internet and email work fine.

history.text: Last year: this laptop was reinstalled, everything normal.

explanation: The laptop and network are healthy; the "Access denied" message means Dimas's account has not been given permission to a restricted server folder. Only the server admin can grant that, after the folder owner approves, so escalate.
hints: Another folder on the same server opens fine. So what is different about this folder?
Read the error message. Who has the authority to grant permission to a server folder?
